meta.description: Structure, components and clinical vocabulary come from the Gurukrupa patient-flow prototype. The colour and type layers are a refresh, not a copy: the prototype's palette had drifted (tokens named teal held navy, green-grey literals survived from an earlier scheme) and seven of its text pairs failed WCAG AA. This system rebuilds both layers around the GK monogram.
meta.brandSource: GK monogram — gold, faceted sapphire, silver. The gold and sapphire ramps below are tuned from that artwork for screen; the mark file itself is not yet in this system.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The app canvas behind every panel. A warm stone, not a blue-grey — it takes its cast from the logo's gold so the sapphire sitting on it reads as the cool thing in the room.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: cards, tables, the top bar, the drawer, modals. Warm white, a half-step above canvas — enough to lift a card without a heavy border.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fills inside a surface: text inputs, table headers, bill rows, token chips. The inverse of a raised card — pressed into the page rather than floating on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The hairline: row separators, card and panel borders. Separation only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed placeholders, drag grips, disabled strokes, the switch track at rest. Decorative marks only — it is 1.5:1 on canvas and carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text — 15.7:1 on surface, 14.1:1 on canvas. Patient names, table values, field content. A deep sapphire-navy rather than black, so type and brand share a hue.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text — 7.1:1 on surface, 6.4:1 on canvas, 5.9:1 on surface-sunk. Labels, card meta, hints, table headers.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text — 5.8:1 on surface, 5.2:1 on canvas, 4.8:1 on surface-sunk. Placeholders, source stamps, empty-state copy. Every text token in this system passes AA on every ground it is used on; there is no decorative-only text colour.

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: The primary action — buttons, active pills, selected borders, links. 7.5:1 on surface. Tuned from the gem at the centre of the monogram.

tokens.name: sapphire-deep
tokens.usage: The hover state of any sapphire fill, and sapphire text that needs more weight on a wash. 11.1:1 on surface, 9.6:1 on sapphire-wash.

tokens.name: sapphire-ink
tokens.usage: The deepest blue — the navigation ground and the rule under the prescription head. Also exported as nav-surface.

tokens.name: sapphire-wash
tokens.usage: Selected and hovered rows, informational chips, matched-medicine rows, the bill total. ink (13.6:1) and sapphire-deep (9.6:1) both read on it.

tokens.name: sapphire-line
tokens.usage: The border that accompanies sapphire-wash — summary cards, selected cards.

tokens.name: on-sapphire
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sapphire or sapphire-deep fill — 7.7:1 and 11.4:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The brand's metal, and the one thing it means in the UI: A CLOCK IS RUNNING. Dilation arcs, the running-timer tag, processing states, the navigation's active indicator. 3.3:1 on surface, so it is a fill and a stroke — never text on light.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: Gold on a navy ground — the active navigation indicator and the focus ring there. 9.3:1 on nav-surface, 7.4:1 on nav-active. Never on surface or canvas.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold as TEXT on light grounds — 6.1:1 on surface, 5.4:1 on gold-wash. The label on a timed chip, the wordmark in print.

tokens.name: gold-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of anything mid-clock: a dilating patient's card, the active protocol step, a processing test.

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: The border that accompanies gold-wash.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill — 4.7:1. White on gold is 3.4:1 and must not be used; the prototype's running-timer tag did exactly that.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Overdue and destructive — the overdue countdown arc, the toast's rule, delete-on-hover. 5.5:1 on surface, so it may carry large text as well as marks.

tokens.name: alert-ink
tokens.usage: Overdue text on alert-wash — 6.4:1.

tokens.name: alert-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of an overdue card, pill or toast action.

tokens.name: alert-line
tokens.usage: The border that accompanies alert-wash.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Completed and confirmed — finished dilation steps, a done test, a checked-in appointment. A CYAN-teal at hue 182°, deliberately off the red–green axis so it is separable from alert by people with red-green colour blindness. 5.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: done-ink
tokens.usage: Completed text on done-wash — 7.0:1.

tokens.name: done-wash
tokens.usage: The ground of a completed state — done tags, the dilation-complete banner, a checked-in button.

tokens.name: done-line
tokens.usage: The border that accompanies done-wash.

tokens.name: whatsapp-ink
tokens.usage: The WhatsApp channel tag's text and border — 4.8:1 on its wash. Borrowed from the channel, not the brand; confined to ChannelTag and the channel toggle.

tokens.name: whatsapp-wash
tokens.usage: The WhatsApp channel tag's ground.

tokens.name: call-ink
tokens.usage: The phone-call channel tag's text and border — 5.5:1 on its wash.

tokens.name: call-wash
tokens.usage: The phone-call channel tag's ground.

tokens.name: nav-surface
tokens.usage: The navigation ground — SideNav, BottomTabBar, the mobile sheet. Same value as sapphire-ink, named for its job so the chrome can move without touching button colours.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: The ground of the current navigation item. Only 1.4:1 against nav-surface, so it never carries the state alone — a gold-bright indicator and the white label carry it.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: The current navigation item's label and icon — 16.3:1 on nav-surface.

tokens.name: nav-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Resting navigation labels, icons and group headings — 8.1:1 on nav-surface, 6.5:1 on nav-active.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring on light grounds — 4.8:1 on surface, 4.3:1 on canvas. 2px solid at 2px offset.

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: The focus ring on navy grounds — 9.3:1 on nav-surface. Applied by the gk-on-navy class.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the drawer and the mobile navigation sheet. Tinted with sapphire-ink rather than neutral black, so the dimmed page stays in the brand's key.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Behind modals, which can open on top of an already-open drawer.

tokens.name: mark-gold
tokens.usage: REFERENCE ONLY — the gold as it appears in the GK monogram artwork. Use the gold ramp above for screen; this value is here so the mark can be matched in print.

tokens.name: mark-sapphire
tokens.usage: REFERENCE ONLY — the gem blue as it appears in the monogram.

tokens.name: mark-silver
tokens.usage: REFERENCE ONLY — the monogram's silver. The UI has no silver; it exists in the mark and in print only.

tokens.name: mark-silver-dim
tokens.usage: REFERENCE ONLY — the silver shadow, and the colour of 'EYE HOSPITAL & LASER CENTER' under the wordmark. 4.9:1 on surface if it is ever set as type.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The hospital name in the top bar. 17px on mobile.

styles.name: drawer-title
styles.usage: The patient's name at the head of the drawer.

styles.name: rx-title
styles.usage: The hospital name on the printed prescription — the heaviest serif in the system.

styles.name: modal-title
styles.usage: Modal headings.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: A patient's name on a queue card — the largest thing on the card, because it is what you are looking for.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Admin and appointment section headings.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: A patient's name in a table row or an appointment.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary and ghost buttons, the select value.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Compact actions sharing a row with a field.

styles.name: option
styles.usage: List-shaped choices — test options, dilation steps, navigation items.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The workhorse: table cells, field values, drawer prose. Raised from the prototype's 12.5px — this is read all day across a room.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A value that must stand out inside body text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Card meta, hints, modal sub-lines.
styles.sample: Dr. Anu Juneja Pathak · Reception desk

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Appointment sub-lines, upload hints, footnotes.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: The label above a field group.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Queue table column headers, in ink-soft.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The uppercase title on a summary card — the only uppercase run in the product.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Status pills and channel tags. Always carries a word.

styles.name: tag-sm
styles.usage: Done tags and step tags.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Values off a diagnostic machine — refraction, IOP, pachymetry. Monospaced because they ARE instrument output and are compared down a column.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Money — bill lines and totals.

styles.name: token
styles.usage: The queue token number.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Clock times, waiting durations, countdowns.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: The provenance stamp on a machine reading. The smallest type in the system.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Stand-in for the GK wordmark, which is a heavy serif — set in the serif family until the real artwork is supplied.

styles.name: byline
styles.usage: The 'created by ai4work' credit in the navigation footer.

spacing.note: A real 4px scale, replacing the prototype's 19 ad-hoc padding values. Everything in the refreshed system lands on it.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets and the gap inside a stacked control.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap on a tab; gaps inside a segmented toggle.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between pills in a status cell.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The default gap: between form rows, bill items, chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list; inner padding of a compact control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, card row spacing, the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, drawer body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top bar padding, modal padding, the gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The desktop page gutter, and the gap between admin blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state height; the gap above a major heading.

radius.note: Five steps, down from the prototype's twelve. Corners are softer throughout — the refreshed system rounds more generously, which is most of why it reads calmer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline tags, token chips, step-order squares.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, buttons, list rows, bill items, condition chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, navigation items, the queue table's outer corner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, the drawer, the bottom bar's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, channel tags, stage pills, the switch track.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The switch knob and any circular marker.

shadow.note: Tinted with sapphire-ink rather than neutral black, so shadows sit in the brand's key against the warm ground. Elevation stays restrained: a card leans on its border and the canvas/surface step, not on a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: A card or row at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: A card under the pointer, and the drop-select menu.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, the drawer, the toast stack — anything floating over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob only.
